summary: JWT signing + requireAuth + assertGroupMember. This is the BACKEND half of the auth task (tgz18gqce8) — already built and tested.
reasoning: Built here rather than in tgz18gqce8 because /auth/register and /auth/login are in this task's declared interface and this exact path is in its scope; without it nothing else could be tested. Whoever claims tgz18gqce8 should re-scope it to part1/ only (AuthContext, LoginPage, RegisterPage). requireAuth re-reads the user row on every request instead of trusting claims baked into the token, so a profile rename or a deleted account takes effect immediately rather than at token expiry — that costs one cheap indexed query per request and is worth it. assertGroupMember is the single authorisation choke point: every route below the group level resolves its owning group id and calls it.
